name: green-strawberry-onesie-bathroom-mirror-selfie
image_purpose: Home outfit post and bathroom mirror selfie

prompt.project_info: Create an unedited realistic vertical bathroom mirror selfie of an approved adult, preserving the deep forest-green strawberry-patterned onesie, black hair, profile pose, and white bathroom setting.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long natural black hair and fair skin, wearing a form-fitting long-sleeved deep forest-green onesie with secure coverage and small red strawberry pattern. She holds a black smartphone and gives a soft subtle smile while glancing back at the mirror.
prompt.composition_elements: Standing in profile with torso slightly turned left, phone in the right hand, relaxed shoulders, and framing from mid-thigh to just above the head. Include white paneled door with silver hardware, white sink and chrome faucet in foreground, and wall switch. Vertical 3:4.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Standard indoor overhead lighting, soft shadows on door panels, bright natural reflections on chrome, warm realistic bathroom atmosphere and slight smartphone grain.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror selfie, chest-height camera, vertical 3:4, realistic fabric and reflection detail, natural proportions.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 3:4 bathroom mirror selfie of an approved adult woman with long natural black hair and fair skin, wearing a form-fitting long-sleeved deep forest-green onesie with secure coverage and small red strawberry pattern. Standing in profile with torso slightly turned to glance back at the mirror, right hand holding a black smartphone, relaxed shoulders and soft subtle smile. White paneled door with silver hardware, white sink and chrome faucet in the foreground, wall switch, standard indoor overhead light, soft shadows, realistic fabric and slight smartphone grain.
